scenario_name: 1. 정상 서버 생성 (Normal Server Creation)
input_precondition: Valid READ_WRITE token + valid Cost Approval + Idempotency-Key
expected_outcome: HTTP 202 -> Worker creates server with tag cloudscanr-op-id -> Polls to RUNNING -> Audit log saved

scenario_name: 2. 잘못된 API Key (Invalid API Key)
input_precondition: User submits malformed or invalid provider API key
expected_outcome: Preflight check returns HTTP 422 INVALID_PROVIDER_CREDENTIALS; zero job queued

scenario_name: 3. 만료된 API Token (Expired API Token)
input_precondition: Connected token expires prior to server provisioning execution
expected_outcome: Preflight detects 401 Expired -> Marks connection EXPIRED -> Fails safely before provisioning

scenario_name: 4. 읽기 전용 토큰으로 서버 생성 (Read-Only Token Provisioning Attempt)
input_precondition: Connection has access_level = READ_ONLY or read-only provider token scope
expected_outcome: Blocked at API gate and preflight with HTTP 403 READ_ONLY_CONNECTION; KMS write path never invoked

scenario_name: 5. 지원되지 않는 리전 (Unsupported / Unavailable Region)
input_precondition: User requests SKU in a region disabled or out-of-stock for their account
expected_outcome: Preflight region check rejects with HTTP 422 REGION_UNAVAILABLE_FOR_ACCOUNT

scenario_name: 6. 지원되지 않는 플랜 (Unsupported / Deprecated Plan)
input_precondition: User requests a deprecated or region-incompatible SKU plan
expected_outcome: Rejected at validation gate with HTTP 422 PLAN_NOT_SUPPORTED_IN_REGION

scenario_name: 7. 잔액 부족 (Insufficient Provider Account Balance)
input_precondition: Provider API returns 402/422 Insufficient Funds / Billing Method Required
expected_outcome: Transition operation to FAILED_SAFE (PROVIDER_INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS) with clear user message; zero retry loop

scenario_name: 8. 한도 초과 (Provider Droplet/vCPU/GPU Quota Exceeded)
input_precondition: Provider API returns 422 Account Instance Limit Reached
expected_outcome: Transition operation to FAILED_SAFE (PROVIDER_QUOTA_EXCEEDED); zero retry loop

scenario_name: 9. 공급업체 API 장애 (Provider API 500/503 Outage)
input_precondition: Provider returns HTTP 503 during preflight or status polling
expected_outcome: Circuit breaker records failure; safe backoff polling; never blind-retries POST /servers without reconciliation

scenario_name: 10. 서버 생성 요청 타임아웃 (Server Creation Request Timeout)
input_precondition: HTTP client times out 30s after sending POST /servers
expected_outcome: Transition to TIMEOUT_RECONCILING -> Query provider by tag cloudscanr-op-id -> Adopt if created, never double-create

scenario_name: 11. 서버 생성 후 응답 유실 (Lost HTTP Response After 201 Created)
input_precondition: Provider creates VM but TCP connection drops before response reaches CloudScanr
expected_outcome: TIMEOUT_RECONCILING discovers VM via tag cloudscanr-op-id -> Links external_resource_id -> Transitions to POLLING_ACTIVE

scenario_name: 12. 중복 요청 (Concurrent Duplicate Provisioning Requests)
input_precondition: Client sends two identical POST /api/v1/cloud/servers requests with same Idempotency-Key or double-clicks
expected_outcome: Database UNIQUE(organization_id, idempotency_key) & single-use approval_id ensure exactly 1 VM is created

scenario_name: 13. 사용자 승인 취소 (User Cancels or Lets Cost Approval Expire)
input_precondition: User revokes approval or waits >5 minutes before submitting POST /servers
expected_outcome: Rejected with HTTP 403 APPROVAL_EXPIRED_OR_REVOKED; zero provider API call made

scenario_name: 14. 서버 삭제 요청 (Destructive Server Deletion Gate)
input_precondition: User requests DELETE /api/v1/cloud/servers/{id}
expected_outcome: Requires exact hostname match + Step-Up MFA + DELETE_SERVER approval_id; logs before/after state

scenario_name: 15. 다른 사용자 서버 접근 (Cross-Tenant IDOR Access Attempt)
input_precondition: User in Org A attempts to view, reboot, or delete Org B's server
expected_outcome: Blocked by Middleware + PostgreSQL RLS + KMS AAD; returns 404 Not Found and logs SECURITY_ALERT

scenario_name: 16. API Token 철회 (Provider API Token Revoked Externally)
input_precondition: User revokes API token inside DigitalOcean/Hetzner console
expected_outcome: Next sync/action detects 401 Unauthorized -> Marks connection REVOKED -> Prompts user to reconnect

scenario_name: 17. 작업 도중 계정 연결 해제 (Account Disconnected Mid-Operation)
input_precondition: Admin disconnects BYOC account while a server operation is in POLLING_ACTIVE
expected_outcome: Worker gracefully aborts further mutations, wipes KMS DEK/ciphertext, and marks operation ABORTED_DISCONNECTED

scenario_name: 18. 서버 리사이징 비용 변경 (Server Resize Cost Delta Approval)
input_precondition: User upgrades 2 vCPU ($24/mo) to 8 vCPU ($96/mo) or permanent disk resize
expected_outcome: Requires explicit RESIZE_SERVER Cost Approval acknowledging the +$72/mo delta and irreversible disk warning

scenario_name: 19. 백업 실패 (Automated Backup or Snapshot Failure)
input_precondition: Provider snapshot/backup action fails due to disk lock or quota
expected_outcome: Records FAILED_SAFE on operation, alerts user in dashboard/email, preserves server running state

scenario_name: 20. 예산 초과 (Organization Monthly Budget Cap Exceeded)
input_precondition: Provisioning or resizing would push monthly run-rate above budget_policies.monthly_limit_usd
expected_outcome: Hard-blocked prior to approval with HTTP 402 BUDGET_POLICY_EXCEEDED unless Owner signs override

scenario_name: 21. 불일치 리소스 Reconciliation (Drift / Orphan Resource Reconciliation)
input_precondition: User creates or deletes a server directly in Provider Console outside CloudScanr
expected_outcome: Scheduled drift scanner detects mismatch, records resource_reconciliations entry, and updates local state

scenario_name: 22. 감사 로그 검증 (Tamper-Evident Audit Log Verification)
input_precondition: Every provisioning, power, resize, delete, and security failure is audited
expected_outcome: Verifies SHA-256 hash chain (prev_hash -> entry_hash) and DB immutability trigger on audit_logs

scenario_name: Sub-50ms Faceted Filter & NL Query Parsing
input_precondition: Query '8 vcpu 32gb nvme frankfurt under $60'
expected_outcome: Returns matching SKUs in <50ms p95 with 5 parsed filter chips

scenario_name: OpenSearch Outage PostgreSQL Fallback
input_precondition: Simulate OpenSearch 503 connection refused
expected_outcome: Search API seamlessly serves results from PostgreSQL indexes with HTTP 200

scenario_name: Click -> Signed SubID Redirect -> Webhook -> Commission Ledger
input_precondition: GET /go/digitalocean-s-2vcpu-4gb followed by signed Impact webhook
expected_outcome: 302 redirect <10ms; click logged; conversion verified; PENDING commission posted

scenario_name: Hetzner Credit vs Cash Commission Segregation
input_precondition: Record Hetzner referral vs Cloudways hybrid sale
expected_outcome: Hetzner recorded as HOSTING_CREDIT; excluded from Cash Revenue KPIs

scenario_name: KMS Envelope Encryption & Log Redaction
input_precondition: Store token and trigger simulated error containing token string
expected_outcome: DB contains only ciphertext+DEK; logs show [REDACTED_SECRET]

scenario_name: 1,500 RPS Public Search & /go/{slug} Stress Test
input_precondition: k6 1500 RPS for 10 minutes
expected_outcome: 0% error rate, search p95 < 50ms, /go/{slug} p99 < 15ms
